about: Offline test set for the speech-aware teleprompter (tools/points-eval.mjs). pos: what the presenter might say in his own words for one point of a real step (step id + point index in steps.points.json). Each pos is also a NEGATIVE for every other point of its step (saying point 1 must not check point 2). off: talk that is not the script at all (it must check nothing, in any step). split: A tunes, B is held out.
